title: KAITO — The Greedy Judge〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Gates of the Hellish Yard

rows.Speaker: Gallerian
rows.Line: I hear a gavel...

rows.Speaker: Gallerian
rows.Line: Does that mean a trial is about to start?

rows.Speaker: Gallerian
rows.Line:
My name?
Am I to take the stand right here, Master of the Hellish Yard?

rows.Speaker: Gallerian
rows.Line: Hah. Fine. We shall see if you can pass judgment on me.

rows.Speaker: Gallerian
rows.Line:
I am Gallerian Marlon.
The Director of the USE Dark Star Bureau.

rows.Speaker: Gallerian
rows.Line:
Wait...
I have only told you my name. How can you already have a verdict?

rows.Speaker: Gallerian
rows.Line:
What am I being charged with?
What about my right to not self-incriminate?

rows.Speaker: Gallerian
rows.Line: And where is the prosecution? Where is my lawyer? Are there any witnesses? You toy with me in such a manner...?!

rows.Speaker: Gallerian
rows.Line: It suits me...?

rows.Speaker: Gallerian
rows.Line: Haha... Hahahaha...

rows.Speaker: Gallerian
rows.Line: Am I being punished for my life's transgression?

rows.Speaker: Gallerian
rows.Line: (If there is anything that I am guilty of, it is for having that affair with Ma...)

rows.Speaker: Gallerian
rows.Line: (Or is it because I did not cherish my wife enough? Or for not going on that trip with her and Michelle?)

rows.Speaker: Gallerian
rows.Line: (If I chose differently then, would my future also have turned out differently?)
One day, in life
Gallerian's Room

rows.Speaker: Gallerian's Voice
rows.Line: You spent more money without asking again...? Just what exactly are you doing with it?!

rows.Speaker: Wife's Voice
rows.Line: Hmph. I already explained everything to you, and you even said, “Do as you please.”

rows.Speaker: Wife's Voice
rows.Line: Whose fault is it for not listening to what I was asking and deciding instead to focus on work?

rows.Speaker: Gallerian's Voice
rows.Line: What?! That means you deliberately chose that point in time to ask!

rows.Speaker: Wife's Voice
rows.Line: Yes, you are correct.

rows.Speaker: Wife's Voice
rows.Line: Isn't a judge's job to hear each side's argument? And yet, you are deaf to what your own wife says. Oh, the irony.

rows.Speaker: Gallerian's Voice
rows.Line: Speak for yourself! What do these dirty tricks say about you as a mother?! Are you not ashamed of yourself?!

rows.Speaker: Gallerian
rows.Line:
...
Fair enough. That money came from her side of the family anyway.

rows.Speaker: Gallerian
rows.Line: And I have more pressing matters to attend to...

rows.Speaker: Gallerian
rows.Line: I am at long last the Director of the USE Dark Star Bureau. Not only that, I still need to read through these court documents.

rows.Speaker: Gallerian
rows.Line: First, I need to...
Daddy, are you still working...?

rows.Speaker: Gallerian
rows.Line: Michelle...?

rows.Speaker: Gallerian
rows.Line: No, dear, come in.

rows.Speaker: Michelle
rows.Line:
Thank you, daddy.
I want to talk to you about my trip...

rows.Speaker: Gallerian
rows.Line: Your trip?

rows.Speaker: Michelle
rows.Line: Yes. I plan on going while I'm still on break since I'll definitely be too busy once I begin university.

rows.Speaker: Gallerian
rows.Line: Are you going with your mother?

rows.Speaker: Michelle
rows.Line: Yes. Which is why you should go too, daddy.

rows.Speaker: Gallerian
rows.Line: I am far too busy to take a vacation right now. I was just appointed as a judge. You must understand.

rows.Speaker: Michelle
rows.Line: I see... That's too bad.

rows.Speaker: Gallerian
rows.Line: It will certainly be lonely...

rows.Speaker: Michelle
rows.Line: The servants will still be here, right? Also, I promise to call every day.

rows.Speaker: Gallerian
rows.Line:
It will still feel lonely.
Please, be careful not to let any strange boys pull one over you.

rows.Speaker: Michelle
rows.Line: Oh, daddy, you're such a worrywart.

rows.Speaker: Michelle
rows.Line: I promise to bring back plenty of souvenirs!

rows.Speaker: Gallerian
rows.Line:
Thank you, Michelle.
Have fun. Enjoy yourself.

rows.Speaker: Gallerian
rows.Line:
My wife and Michelle took their trip...
Across the ocean to my old home...

rows.Speaker: Gallerian
rows.Line: Michelle even called me every day like she promised, and told me about what happened each day in that cheerful tone of hers.

rows.Speaker: Gallerian
rows.Line: She also finished each call with, “Let's talk more once I get back!”...

rows.Speaker: Gallerian
rows.Line: She seemed so happy whenever she called me.

rows.Speaker: Gallerian
rows.Line: However...

rows.Speaker: Gallerian
rows.Line: She never came back...

rows.Speaker: Gallerian
rows.Line: Who goes there...?

rows.Speaker: Gallerian
rows.Line:
(I fired all of the servants...
There should be nobody else except...)
Pardon my intrusion, Gallerian.

rows.Speaker: Gallerian
rows.Line: Ma... What are you doing here...?

rows.Speaker: Ma
rows.Line: You look terrible. Have you been eating? What would Michelle say if she ever saw you in such a state...?

rows.Speaker: Gallerian
rows.Line: You dare speak her name in my presence?!

rows.Speaker: Ma
rows.Line:
My, all that rage.
Just take a deep breath.

rows.Speaker: Ma
rows.Line: If you cannot stay calm, I will not be able to tell you about how to get Michelle back.

rows.Speaker: Gallerian
rows.Line: What do you mean...?

rows.Speaker: Ma
rows.Line: Do you remember our discussion surrounding the “Vessels of Sin”...?

rows.Speaker: Ma
rows.Line: The Venom Sword, the Glass of Conchita, the Four Mirrors of Lucifenia, the Clockworker's Doll, Kayo's Scissors, the Marlon Spoon and Grim the End...

rows.Speaker: Gallerian
rows.Line: Yes, I remember...

rows.Speaker: Gallerian
rows.Line: Each is inhabited by a demon and those who enter into a deal with them are blessed with various powers, but...

rows.Speaker: Gallerian
rows.Line: Most all end up destroying themselves.

rows.Speaker: Ma
rows.Line: Indeed. Each “crime” is accompanied by a “punishment”.

rows.Speaker: Ma
rows.Line:
Gallerian...
You are to gather the “Vessels of Sin”.

rows.Speaker: Gallerian
rows.Line: What...? You expect me to destroy myself after losing my beloved daughter?

rows.Speaker: Ma
rows.Line: No. Do you not recall the other piece of information that I mentioned regarding the “Vessels of Sin”?

rows.Speaker: Ma
rows.Line: How gathering all seven allows that person to have their wish granted?

rows.Speaker: Gallerian
rows.Line: Any wish...?

rows.Speaker: Ma
rows.Line: Any wish. Not only that, the Marlon Spoon, one of the “Vessels of Sin”, is already in your possession.

rows.Speaker: Gallerian
rows.Line: What...?

rows.Speaker: Ma
rows.Line: However, the Demon of Greed is not inhabiting it, so you will not be able to access its powers.

rows.Speaker: Ma
rows.Line: Instead, it is being inhabited by the spirit of “the one searching for whom they love”.

rows.Speaker: Gallerian
rows.Line: Whom they love...

rows.Speaker: Ma
rows.Line: That spirit will surely be able to guide you.

rows.Speaker: Ma
rows.Line: Now, you must submit yourself to it...

rows.Speaker: Ma
rows.Line: Make up your mind, Gallerian Marlon...!

rows.Speaker: Gallerian
rows.Line: Michelle...

rows.Speaker: Gallerian
rows.Line: (If it means getting to see you again, I will gladly submit myself to a demon.)
